title: Immune gene and protein profiles across blood, cerebrospinal fluid and peripheral nerve in inflammatory neuropathies
description: Public aggregate materials accompanying the Human Genomics submission manuscript v42. Version 2.3.0 includes the revised manuscript with five embedded main figures and three editable tables, updated figure labels and legends, the edited graphical abstract, four supplementary figures, a 49 worksheet aggregate data workbook, supplementary methods, analysis and plotting scripts, and database access documentation. The analysis results are unchanged from version 2.2.0. Code is MIT licensed. Project derived data and figures are CC BY 4.0. External source materials retain their original terms.
